title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, dashboard panels, and alert tuning
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Added token-level KV cache metrics and new dashboard panels for KV cache hit/miss/eviction rates. Introduced tuned alert rules for sustained KV miss rates and high token-cost regressions. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation:
We need better visibility into per-token KV cache behavior to diagnose cost regressions and tail-latency sources. Current observability surfaces aggregated cache stats which hide per-request and per-token patterns, making it hard to triage regressions after model upgrades or kernel changes.

Summary of changes:
- Instrumented token-level KV cache events (hit, miss, eviction, read_latency_ns) and exported counters/histograms with labels: model, deployment, route, region, request_id_prefix.
- Added derived metrics for token-level cost attribution: token_cost_estimate, tokens_served_by_kv_cache_percent.
- New Grafana dashboard: "KV Cache — Token Level" with panels for hit/miss rate over time, cost attribution, heatmap of per-request token latency, and top routes by miss rate.
- Alert tuning: added SLO-based alerts and adaptive burn-window alert for sustained miss-rate > 5% for 15m (service-critical) and cost-regression alert when token_cost_estimate increases > 20% over baseline for 1h.
- Small runtime change: added lightweight sampling path to attach token-level telemetry to 1% of requests by default to keep cardinality manageable. Sampling is configurable via feature flag.

Checklist:
- [x] Metrics schema reviewed with Metrics team
- [x] Dashboards created and smoke-tested in staging
- [x] Alerts reviewed and tuned with SRE on-call
- [x] Feature-flagged sampling and documentation added

How tested:
- Unit tests for metric emission added and running in CI
- Integration test in staging sending synthetic workload with controlled KV miss ratios; verified dashboard panels reflect expected signals and alerts fire/rate-limit as intended
- Load test with 10k RPS synthetic traffic sampling enabled verified no measurable CPU/latency regression (<1% increase)

Notes for rollout:
- Sampling off by default in production; enable via config: observability.kv_token_sampling_rate (0.01)
